title: Add backup and restore MVP

context.summary: Add documented and scripted backup/restore for the single-home Mindory install layout.
context.background: The installer already owns MINDORY_HOME, update backups and uninstall backups. Public readiness still needs an operator-facing backup/restore command that covers config, PostgreSQL and local object storage state.

in: Add installer package APIs for creating and restoring runtime backups under MINDORY_HOME/backups.
Back up config, installer metadata, PostgreSQL through Docker Compose pg_dump and local object storage data where applicable.
Restore config, PostgreSQL through Docker Compose psql and local object storage data with explicit confirmation.
Add CLI commands for backup and restore with dry-run and component toggles.
Add smoke validation for backup manifest, local object copy, Compose command planning and restore behavior.
Update installer, deployment, production hardening and repository status docs.

acceptance_criteria: Installer exports backup and restore APIs with component reports and a manifest file.
Backup copies config and installer metadata into a timestamped backup directory.
Backup captures PostgreSQL with Docker Compose pg_dump when enabled.
Backup captures local filesystem object storage and LibreFS bind-mounted data where applicable.
Restore requires explicit confirmation and can restore config, PostgreSQL and local object storage components.
CLI exposes backup and restore commands with clear options.
Docs describe backup/restore scope, commands, limitations and smoke validation.

manual_checks: Confirm restore refuses to run without explicit yes/--yes.
Confirm docs still classify PITR, remote encrypted backups and external S3 streaming backups as future hardening.

risks: Restore must not silently overwrite runtime state without confirmation.
External S3 cannot be fully copied without provider-specific bucket listing and credentials policy.
Postgres restore assumes the Compose postgres service is running and has psql available.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
